resources.string: Your cat in a round window: start a block, watch the kitten grow, answer check-ins.
Start a block in one tap: 15, 25 or 50 minutes, or a stopwatch.
Your daily goal, your streak and your missions, with Collect when a reward is waiting.
Your Later list: tick things off, start a block with one, or park a thought.
The sounds you focus to, with their volume, and play and pause.
Your streak in days, with a paw for each day of the week.
Today\'s focus as a ring, and what\'s left of your goal.
Today\'s missions, with a Collect button when a reward is waiting.
Tap your cat and it hops; tap again and it purrs. Boo sleeps late.
The time and the date, and what your cat is up to. Boo comes out late.
This month as a night sky: a star for every block that came home.
The last seven days as little skies, each with the cat that came home.
Your café with today\'s cats; in dark mode, the month\'s, at night.
Who\'s focusing, who\'s on a break, and how long they have left.
